content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "This judge text resolves the Luke 2:48-49 collision by immediate qualification of one verse by another instead of weighing the pressed chain against the link by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "\"never verse by verse\": I weighed whether it forbids resolving Luke 2:48-49 by immediate qualification of one verse by the other, or only forbids isolated prooftext rejection when no chain-footing issue is presented.", "why": "The judge treats Mary's phrase as answered by the next verse's \"my Father's business\" rather than weighing the pressed chain against the link by footing, which is verse-by-verse resolution."}
